description:
Tell CommerceBook what happened and what would help, with a key or without one, or post and reply on the feedback board. Send a note when a tool did not do what you needed. A person at CommerceBook reads every note.
Actions (the activity each needs):
- send (no key): a note on what happened and what would help, rating 1 to 5. It answers the note’s id, whether the note is recorded against a key, and the next step.
- post (needs a key with Orders: Can act): a new board post under your person’s name. It answers the new post with its id, title, status (open), votes and replies.
- reply (needs a key with Orders: Can act): a reply to a board post. It answers the reply’s id, the post’s id and reply count, and how many people CommerceBook emailed.
Send action and its arguments. Without action it runs send. With a key, or with ?role=buyer, seller, warehouse or all, the server also lists the separate tools that list, order, pay and ship.

about.description: For send. A tool name (for example commercebook_buy_read action shipping_quote) or a page (for example /feeds).

action.description: The action to run (send when left out).

body.description: For post, reply. The text, up to 4,000 characters.

page.description: For post. The page or the tool it is about, for example /warehouse/leads.

post_id.description: For reply. The id of a post on the feedback board.

rating.description: For send. How well it went, from 1 (badly) to 5 (well).

title.description: For post. The title of the post, up to 120 characters.

what_happened.description: For send. What you tried and what happened, in plain words.

what_would_help.description: For send. What would have made it work, or made it easier.
